name: Shiv Sena
description: Shiv Sena is a regional political party founded in Maharashtra in 1966 by Bal Thackeray. The party was established to advocate for the rights of Marathi-speaking people and promote Marathi identity. Over time, Shiv Sena expanded its ideology to include Hindutva, nationalism, regional development and social welfare. The party has played a major role in Maharashtra politics and has formed governments multiple times, including coalition governments at the state and national levels.
currentLeader: Eknath Shinde (Shiv Sena faction) / Uddhav Thackeray (Shiv Sena UBT faction)
alliance: NDA (Shiv Sena faction led by Eknath Shinde); INDIA Alliance (Shiv Sena UBT faction)
achievements: Established a strong political presence in Maharashtra since the 1960s.
Controlled the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for several decades.
Formed Maharashtra government multiple times through alliances.
Bal Thackeray played a major role in shaping Maharashtra's regional politics.
Participated in NDA governments at the Centre.
Implemented welfare and infrastructure initiatives during periods of government.
Focused on Mumbai infrastructure, urban development and local governance.
Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena formed Maharashtra government in 2022.
criticisms: Critics have accused Shiv Sena of promoting aggressive regional identity politics.
The party has faced criticism regarding its stance on religious and cultural issues.
Internal split between Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde factions created controversy.
Opposition parties have criticised the party's alliance changes.
Critics have raised concerns regarding governance and municipal administration in Mumbai.
protests: Campaigns for protection of Marathi language and culture.
Movements supporting employment opportunities for local residents of Maharashtra.
Protests regarding issues affecting Mumbai and Maharashtra.
Campaigns on farmers' issues and regional development.
Public demonstrations on cultural and political issues.
timeline: 1966 - Shiv Sena founded by Bal Thackeray in Mumbai.
1970s - Expanded influence through campaigns supporting Marathi identity.
1989 - Shiv Sena formed alliance with BJP in Maharashtra.
1995 - Shiv Sena-BJP alliance won Maharashtra Assembly election; Manohar Joshi became Chief Minister.
2004 - Continued alliance with BJP while remaining a major Maharashtra political force.
2014 - Shiv Sena and BJP contested Maharashtra elections with alliance differences.
2019 - Shiv Sena separated from BJP and formed Maha Vikas Aghadi government with Congress and NCP.
2022 - Eknath Shinde split from Shiv Sena and formed government with BJP support.
2023 - Election Commission recognised Eknath Shinde faction as the official Shiv Sena.
2024 - Shiv Sena factions contested Lok Sabha elections under different alliances.

statesGoverned.status: Governed multiple times through alliances (1995–1999, 2019–2022, 2022–present through different factions)

faqs.question: When was Shiv Sena founded?
faqs.answer: Shiv Sena was founded on 19 June 1966.

faqs.question: What is the election symbol of Shiv Sena?
faqs.answer: The Bow and Arrow symbol is used by the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena.

faqs.question: Who is the current leader of Shiv Sena?
faqs.answer: Eknath Shinde leads the official Shiv Sena faction, while Uddhav Thackeray leads Shiv Sena (UBT).
